receipt.public_excerpt: Q1 net loss exceeded $21.3 billion, of which approximately $12.4 billion consisted of non-cash accounting charges. Even after stripping out these expenses, the Q1 operating loss remained as high as $9.3 billion.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI, the largest AI lab, lost money in Q1 2026 by both measures: a $21.3 billion net loss and a $9.3 billion operating loss.

receipt.public_excerpt: Anthropic, the artificial intelligence (AI) company known for creating the chatbot Claude, recorded a net loss of more than $80bn in the first half of 2026

evidence_items.explanation: The second major AI lab also had a large net loss over January to June 2026, although most of it came from non-cash charges.

receipt.public_excerpt: On an operating basis, the loss narrowed to $693 million from $2.1 billion, and the company booked $974 million in operating income in the second quarter.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic made an operating profit in Q2 2026, the quarter the post falls in. That cuts against a strong reading of 'not profitable yet' for at least one lab. Its first-half results were still an operating loss and a net loss.
